what_we_now_know: Mother-and-son dance video (young son, not an adult) circulated on r/ZyadaKuchNai during the window: a boy forgets his choreography and his mother joins in -- a single parent-child dance clip, not the mother/adult-son matching-outfit synchronized trend described. Documented instance of the mother-son dance-video genre: Philadelphia-area couple Tim and Tolly Sherry went viral after a wedding dance involving their son, performing to Earth, Wind & Fire. Dated ~3.5 months BEFORE the window under review (2026-09-10 to 2026-11-05), so it corroborates the genre but is not in-window evidence. Mother-son living-room jive by Thomas Hayes (20) and mother Sarah Hayes of northwest England went viral. Pre-window (Oct 2024); illustrates the core format of a mother and adult son performing a synchronized routine at home. Mother-and-son terrace dance to the song "Mallipoo" drew wide attention; this is the one located instance that actually supports the coordinated-attire element of the subject description. Pre-window (Aug 2023). TikTok mother-son "Charm" dance challenge video that spread widely on the platform — evidence the format recurs as a named dance challenge, not only as one-off clips. Pre-window (Jul 2023). Earlier TikTok instance of the same genre ("Let's Groove" challenge), showing the mother-son choreographed-routine format predates the window by years. Pre-window (Sep 2021).
